title: PipelineAnalyzeProposalResponse
description: Dry analyze over a not-yet-created PipelineProposal (HEL-381): the projected source schema per root, per-step input/output schema, any per-step validation errors, and (HEL-914 task 6b.4a) every proposed Output's fieldMapping validity grounded at that Output's own target node (or root schema, for a root-bound Output) -- never the pipeline trunk. Nothing is persisted. Additive sibling of GET /api/pipelines/:id/analyze's PipelineAnalyzeResponse -- carries no id/outputDataTypeId, since nothing has been created yet (design.md D4). HEL-914: `sourceName`/`sourceSchema` (singular) REPLACED outright by `sourceSchemas`, one entry per proposed root, matching the persisted-pipeline twin's `RootSourceSchema` $def exactly so the two shapes cannot drift. The steps[] shape mirrors the ACTUAL discriminated-union wire format analyzeStepResponseFormat already emits (a `type` discriminator plus an object `config`), NOT pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json's stale `op`/string-`config` $defs.AnalyzeStep, which predates the CS2c-3a discriminated-union rework (design.md D6).

AnalyzeProposalStep.description: Matches the actual analyzeStepResponseFormat wire shape (type discriminator + object config) -- a deliberate divergence from pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json's stale $defs.AnalyzeStep (op/string-config, pre-CS2c-3a). `config` is a permissive object (additionalProperties: true) rather than a full per-kind oneOf union across all step kinds -- more precision than this ticket's scope needs (design.md D6).

OutputAnalyze.description: HEL-914 task 6b.4a: one entry per proposed Output, in request order. `validationError` is present only when that Output's fieldMapping is invalid at its own grounded node -- absent when valid or when the Output has no fieldMapping.
